items.note: S1.1.1.1.1.1.1 states the paper's lemma correctly: each forward invocation adds x_S to y_S whatever the scratch values, and three stages send (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) and restore every scratch wire. The eight-row schedule, the net map (JV+RG)x, the coefficient cancellation and h=100, N, m are not given, so it is not derived.

States that a common frame commutes with a pointwise linear gate, so the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1} and only the endpoint frames matter (lines 812-825). It is a one-line infer step, not a derivation with sub-steps.

States nondegenerate labels nested along every edge, with central-wire returns as the only decreasing edges, and the budget Wm-2N+2L. It omits the loss h per decreasing edge, L=Ich and the ratios L/N=100/539 and 101/539. It also calls Wm-2N+2L the 'total rank cost', but the paper's equation 1006 is a sum of dimension changes.

Gets right the XOR gates, the projections P_U, the role permutation, endpoint matrices differing by I_m (the shear H<-H+D) and s<Wm. It omits the source matrices -P_{U_a} and the formula s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, including the N rank-one source edges (1162-1166). Together with S1.1.1.1.1.1.3 it suggests s_b=Wm-2N+2L.

Gets right that each edge's frame change is a product of kernels aI+bX_v, one per orthonormal residual vector. It does not define the phase frames C_U and omits s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c. It also omits the source/sink Z corrections and the i^{27k} scalar that the paper needs before every role gets C^{otimes m} (1297-1314); it attributes that result to telescoping alone.

Correctly states s<Wm and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and the show step's route (gadgets, frames, labels, adding ranks) follows the paper. The essential steps are missing: L/N<1/2 giving the deficit N-2L>0, the deficits eta_b and eta_c, and the argument from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20. The exponent is only asserted. The complex exponent sigma is not stated here.

Controlled shifts and the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W are used in steps (S1.1.1.1.1.2.2, S1.1.1.1.1.3), but the lemmas' general content (digit moves, split/merge, O(V) updates with b^{O(1)} offsets) is never stated.

The factorization E_1 Pi E_2, the O(V) lower-triangular updates in descending physical order and one interchange per one of Pi between two controlled updates all match lines 1425-1446. Two parts of the paper's derivation are missing: the choice of a fixed odd prime q avoiding all denominators and diagonal numerators, so that the identities specialize mod q^b (1413-1423), and the elimination proof of the factorization (1375-1391).

The sub-steps follow the paper's proof: cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, each edge done by recursive shears, pointwise gates, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows, two linear updates to interchange, the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) solved to O(e^tau), and the parking-stack schedule. The statement's 'enough rows' loosens the hypothesis that the row field has length divisible by W^k.
Correctly states O(Vu^tau) for any prefix, gap and suffix lengths, with a one-line summary (base-m pieces, rows from high digits, padding). The construction at 1650-1734 is not broken into sub-steps.

Gets right one child call per residual direction on the f axes of a slot after a binary change of basis, and H_0^{otimes D}=b^D S_D C^{otimes D} S_D. It omits the inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{otimes f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, which keeps every child a forward call, and does not state that the total is exactly s_c children.

The statement (XOR of selected bits, third chunk restored, O(V(L^tau+1)) in the family) and the route (cyclic shifts correct off a bad set, extraction and radix-sort repair, bad fraction 80(f-1)2^{-K}) match the paper. The eight-operation parity construction behind the shifts (2016-2041) is not given, nor the fact that T_0 S_0^{-1} permutes the bad set, which makes the sort keys distinct (2182-2183).

The node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), the row split giving volume V/W and the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with a stop at e<d^beta are right. Missing: the leaf bound F(e)=O(e), the condition max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}<lambda', and the unrolling (internal sum O(e^lambda), leaves O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), base-m pieces).

The statement (O(Vd^{lambda'}), one truncation, error below sqrt2 2^{-p}, result in the unit disk) and the route (phase network, packed changes of basis, row split, recurrence, return to H_0) follow the paper. The guard-width bound is only asserted ('o(p) guard bits'), without the arithmetic-depth recurrence or Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}).

The statement covers character cancellation, F^+F^-=t^{-1}I, decimation in frequency, the stored bit-reversed order, the layout L, the error sqrt2 ell 2^{-p} and the three-part cost. The sub-steps follow the paper's cost derivation: prefix moves O(TpdK), at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges giving O(Tp pK^{tau-1}), and ell simultaneous layers. The error accumulation is asserted rather than shown.
Correctly states Kronecker packing at B_0=2^{4p}, four integer products, cost O(rp log(rp)) and return of Q_p(fg/r). The centered-residue recovery is not shown.

The error sqrt2 M(3ell+1)2^{-p} and the cost match. The route is the paper's: two forward transforms kept in the common LB order, pointwise products commuting with LB, the opposite transform and an exact scale by M. The error sum is asserted rather than worked out.

Correctly states the one-dimensional identity P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA with error below p^2 and time O(tp^{3/2+delta}alpha), and the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2 and the line-exposure cost. The hypothesis alpha^4 theta>p appears in S1.4.3. The construction of A and B_0 is not shown.
Both identities are stated correctly. S1.2.4 also gives the key reason: t_i is a unit mod s_i, so RF^+R=F^+.

The fixed exponents, the sizes, the band constants, the prime intervals with eta=1/(4d), T/2<S<T via (1-1/(2d))^d>1/2, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the trial-division search in n^{o(1)} time and the no-wraparound digit bound all match the paper.
The isomorphism x -> prod x_i^{mu_i}, the triangular mixed-radix coordinates and the prefix-controlled cyclic shifts with cost O(Tpd^2(1+ell^tau)) follow the paper.

The twist x_d -> zeta y is well defined because (zeta y)^r=1, the wrap check gives zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, the computed version twists, convolves and untwists, and the cost is O(Tp^{1+delta}). All match the paper.
The chirp procedure, the source transform 2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A = RF_s with its conjugate for the opposite sign, the six algorithm steps and the role of the two occurrences of S all match the paper.

Correctly states the contraction-and-margin strategy, the .7 norm margin, the final error 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 and the carry recurrence. The intermediate bounds E_s=9*2^gamma TL and E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L, and the use of gamma<=b/4, are missing.

Correctly states min g_i=2^{-181}=2kappa, the o(V) setup, the log-power absorption and the final bound. The seven normalized cost terms and their exponents of p are not listed, so the margin computation is only cited.
S0 lists nlogn-conjecture under relies-on, and its motivation mentions Theta(n log n), but no step states the liminf negation argument.

errors.says: Nested labels make each edge cost its label-dimension change, so the total rank cost is Wm-2N+2L.
errors.paper: Wm-2N+2L is the sum of absolute label-dimension changes (eq:rank-budget-labels). For the bit network that drives the interchange, the N source edges have rank one with zero dimension change, so the rank sum is s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b and the deficit is N-2L_b. This is why the paper needs L<N/2 (895-897, 1162-1167, 1472-1473).

errors.says: Telescoping the phase frames gives C^{otimes m} on every role, scratch roles included.
errors.paper: Telescoping gives C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) for the route X_a->Y_a. C^{otimes m} on every role holds only after the Z_{a,k} source/sink corrections, the scalar i^{27k}, negating the X outputs and undoing the exchange (1225-1227, 1297-1314).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: rank-saving network, matrix shear, power-width recurrence, arbitrary-width interchange and the phase-network butterfly layer, then synthetic transforms, ring convolution, twist, chirp, resampling, CRT, precision and the cost table. It thins at the core of the saving. The labels-to-rank step equates the rank sum with the dimension budget Wm-2N+2L, omitting the N rank-one source edges and never stating L=Ich, L/N=100/539<1/2 or the eta argument behind tau=1-2^{-50}. So s<Wm and s/W<m^tau are asserted, not derived. Lower down, guard widths, the layer recurrence's unrolling and the error bookkeeping are asserted rather than shown.

steps.note: The plan has the bank exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) restoring every scratch wire, built from three-element-subset gadgets. It never gives h=100, the indexing by triples a in T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 or m=h^3. Since these quantities are part of the defining content, this is the conservative verdict.

States that the common frame commutes with pointwise gates, so the network on arrays implements D_out S D_in^{-1} and only the endpoint frames matter. The method of S1.1.1.1.1.1 ties frames to cheap edge changes.

Has nondegenerate subspace labels, nested along every edge, with central-wire returns as the only decreasing edges (quoting line 999, time 3 to 4). The loss h per such edge and the ambient space F^{otimes3} of dimension m are not given, which weakens this verdict.

Says only that each edge 'costs its label-dimension change' and that the frames are projections P_U. It omits the mechanism rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U and the N rank-one source edges; its total in fact leaves them out.
Gives the dimension budget Wm-2N+2L but calls it the rank total. It omits L=Ich and never reaches s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b; S1.1.1.1.1.1.4 says only s<Wm.
Asserts the strict saving s<Wm but gives no L/N=100/539 or 101/539, no comparison with 1/2 and no deficit N-2L>0.

States that the endpoint matrices differ by I_m on every role, so the bit network applies H<-H+D to every row, including scratch rows. The source matrices -P_{U_a} that produce the identity are not given.
Has the factorization E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), each edge done by recursive pivot interchanges, and s recursive calls per node.
Gives children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau). The justification of tau (eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20) is missing; the value is only quoted.

central.summary: Five of nine steps are reconstructed (C2, C3, C7, C8, C9): the frames, the endpoint shear, the rank-to-interchange mechanism and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The middle of the chain, where the saving is actually produced, is thin or misstated. The plan gives no h=100, N or m, no rank(P_V-P_U)=dim change with the N rank-one source exceptions, and no L=Ich or L/N=100/539<1/2. It also equates the rank total with the dimension budget Wm-2N+2L. So s<Wm is asserted, not reconstructed.
